name: Terrarium 65x35x35
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 65x35x35 cm. Volume: 79.6 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: Dimensions of 65x35x35 cm give 2275 cm² of floor and about 80 liters. The model is 5 cm longer than the standard 60 cm ones, and with a width and height of 35 cm it has a balanced cross-section. It has no 3D background, so the whole depth is free. Air flows through mesh vents.

A young ball python has two hides at the ends here and a water dish in the middle. For young tortoises and a blue-tongued skink the floor is enough for the first year or two. For an adult bearded dragon the area is too small, so we recommend it only for a juvenile until it moves to a 100 cm terrarium.

The wider model of the same length is the 65x40x40. If your space allows exactly 65 cm and you need a different height, we build it to order. The film pattern for the outer sides is chosen before the build. The build takes 7 to 14 days, and the terrarium arrives by courier.
